effects.effect: Whenever you force move a creature, you can spend up to 2 [surges](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge). For each [surge](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge) spent, the [forced movement](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) [distance](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) gains a bonus equal to your [Reason](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason) score.
